name: daylight-toggle
title: Daylight Toggle
description: A day-and-night switch with a living harbour inside. Drag the brass porthole lens across the bay to shift from noon sun to dusk and moonlit night, with water shimmer, lighthouse beam, and pixel-art dithering.
blurb: A living harbour daylight toggle with an animated seaside scene and brass lens.
note: drag the brass lens across the bay, or click it
